name: Dragon Fly
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold the bench behind your head.
Lift your legs and hips up so your body is in a near-vertical line.
Slowly lower your straight legs as far as you can control.
Keep your lower back from arching.
Raise your legs back up by squeezing your abs.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A dragon-flag style exercise where the legs sweep down and up while your upper back is supported.

safetyNotes: Advanced; use a modified version to build up and skip it with back pain.
